verdict.rationale: Docs show spend tracking broken down by project, API key, and team member, budgets settable per team/project/key/user, and Usage/Requests/Logs dashboards with model/provider filters and CSV/JSON export — covering the core dimensions of the story (model, key, team, user, cross-provider). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the dashboard's granularity and no explicit evidence of per-model spend breakdown in the UI beyond filtering.
